title: Classroom rooms: one fixed room, or a new room each session?
file: swayamvar/, stock-rush/, stock-rush-pro/, swipe-right-sip-live.html (fixed) · quiz, the-wealth-hack, fund-manager, sapno-ka-ghar, broke-by-friday-live (per session)
verdict: Recommendation: a NEW room every session, everywhere, made as easy as a fixed room. Fixed rooms (Swayamvar 1995, Swipe Right MF101, Stock Rush TEEN, Stock Rush PRO's GO25 fallback) are simple and printable, but two classes collide, old scores show when the screen opens, and anyone with the link can watch or reset a live class. Per-session rooms (Quiz, Wealth Hack, MF Manager, Sapno, BBF) keep classes apart and safe, and they gave us the usage data (1,044 rooms). Players never need a fixed code anyway: they scan the QR on the projector.

items.text: Move Swayamvar, Swipe Right LIVE, Stock Rush teen and Stock Rush PRO to a new room per session, like the quiz and Wealth Hack, so two classes can never collide and old scores never appear.
Give Hiral one bookmarkable host link per game that always opens or resumes HER latest room. That keeps the convenience of a fixed room, without a shared room strangers can reach.

Make every host screen survive a refresh: remember the host's room on that device and offer 'Resume or start fresh' (Stock Rush PRO already does this; the quiz, Wealth Hack, Sapno and BBF lose the lobby today).
Only the host's own device sees host controls (Reset, Next, Reveal). A plain player link should never show them.
Use one room-code style everywhere: 4 characters, no look-alike letters (no O/0, I/1), shown big beside the QR, with a typed-code join box on the phone that actually works.
Build one shared 'rooms' module that all 9 classroom games use (create, join, resume, expire after 6 hours), instead of nine slightly different versions.
Tag each room with game name and date so the room history becomes a simple usage report: which games Hiral runs, how many players, and how far each got.
